label: preparing
what: Likely an undisclosed gathering or reception in the great hall around day 1, 18:00: innkeeper, freight and builder were already waiting among low-placed lanterns and several chests. A surprise celebration is possible but not established. Baker and neighbour may be involved, given bakery gathering reports and the neighbour arranging the mayor's attendance, but knowing involvement is unproven; no additional knowing helpers can be identified confidently.
